responsibility: This implementation module is the central GNU Modula-2 runtime services hub. It delegates module dependency construction to M2Dependent, maintains doubly ended lists of installed initial and termination procedures, implements HALT/Terminate and location-aware error exits, provides runtime open-array length calculation, and maps compiler-generated runtime checks to RTExceptions raises using the M2EXCEPTION enumeration. It is the main coordination layer between generated code, the dependency manager, and the exception machinery.
same_name_distinction: This is the executable side of the M2RTS pair: it implements the declared runtime services, forwards module registration/construction work to M2Dependent, maintains procedure lists, and raises M2EXCEPTION-classified failures through RTExceptions. Unlike gcc/m2/gm2-libs/M2RTS.def, it is the coordinating implementation.
